institutions.name: KU Leuven
institutions.entity_note: Non-EEA applicants (including Turkish students) must apply online through the KU Leuven Admissions Office by programme deadlines (mostly 1 March or 1 May for master's, 15 January to 1 April for bachelor's), with verified prior degrees and an English test (general minimum IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 79, most programmes higher). For Turkey, KU Leuven's bachelor eligibility list requires the Lise Diploması plus YKS results; no Turkey-specific master's rules are published and the 2026/27 non-EEA tuition is mostly EUR 9,493.92 for 60 credits (reduced for some programmes).
